title: End-of-season gear collection and storage kickoff
description: Kick off end-of-season to-do items: concessions clean out, gear bag/bin collection, batting cage nets, upstairs cleanout, and banner retrieval.

title: Bat/ball/team equipment replacement purchases for next season
description: Identify and order bat/ball/team equipment replacements for next season within approved caps (bats not to exceed $2,000; balls $1,400-$2,500).

title: Equipment inventory and needs discussion
description: Present equipment inventory and needs at the board meeting: bats, baseballs, catcher's gear, mowers/tractors, bins, and storage security.

title: Fall equipment inventory
description: Complete the fall equipment inventory to establish what is on hand and what must be replaced before the coming season.

title: Season prep equipment purchases (winter)
description: Order season-prep equipment: helmets, catcher's gear, baseballs/softballs, bats, and nets ahead of spring.

title: Season prep equipment purchases (balls, tees, cage)
description: Continue season-prep purchasing: balls, helmets, catcher's gear, bats, tees, and batting cage supplies.

title: Equipment inventory and pre-season purchasing
description: Run the pre-season inventory and purchasing pass: helmets, catcher's gear, baseballs/softballs, bats, tees, and nets.

title: Team and field equipment purchases (spending motion)
description: Bring team and field equipment purchases (helmets, catcher's gear, balls, bats, mowers, drags) to the board with a spending motion (e.g. up to {{amount}} at discretion of president + equipment manager).

title: Tee Ball / Coach Pitch field setup
description: Set up Tee Ball / Coach Pitch fields with bins, gear, and helmets per field ahead of the season start.

title: Ball order and season equipment stocking
description: Place the baseballs/softballs order and stock season equipment (tees, buckets, helmets, catcher's gear).

title: Equipment setup volunteer recruitment
description: Recruit volunteers to assemble the gear bins for each field, setting up pop-up tents to organize gear by field.

title: End-of-season gear collection, sort, and storage
description: Collect, sort, and store end-of-season gear: gear bags, bins, batting cage nets, and uniforms.

title: Equipment inventory scheduling and volunteer recruitment
description: Schedule the next equipment inventory and recruit volunteers to help count and organize gear.

title: End-of-season field cleanup priorities by field
description: Set fall cleanup and maintenance priorities per field: fencing, base paths, mounds, dugouts, drag, aerate/fertilize. Review at the fall board meeting.

title: Fall field improvement/planning projects review
description: Plan fall field improvement projects: Intervale, Bennett Rd, Douglass, lights, batting cages, and 50/70 conversions.

title: Fall fertilizer/aeration purchase
description: Purchase fall fertilizer and schedule aeration for fields (recurring fertilizer authorization up to ~{{amount}} for Douglas/Penney).

title: Fall field maintenance & equipment planning
description: Review fall maintenance and planning: fertilizer, field conversions, and grounds equipment (mowers, sheds).

title: Douglass field improvements review
description: Report on Douglass/Douglas field improvements: batting cage, infield mix, net and poles.

title: End-of-season fields wrap-up: banners/cages, clean fields
description: Take down banners and batting cage nets, and complete final field cleanup for the season.

title: Field maintenance/improvement & grounds equipment planning
description: Pre-season planning for grounds equipment (mowers, drag, sheds, fertilizer, batting cages) and set field cleanup dates.

title: Field cleanup days scheduled and grounds prep
description: Schedule spring field cleanup days and grounds prep: dragging, spraying, fertilizer, infield mix, cage and banner work ahead of first games.

title: Field cleanup, locks, drags, and in-season mowing
description: Field cleanup, lock installation, dragging, and start of in-season mowing rotation as the season begins.

title: Field conversion / improvement projects update
description: Update on field conversion and improvement projects: outfield wall, Intervale, batting cages, and field strips.

title: Ground crew team recognition and staffing
description: Recognize the ground crew volunteers and confirm staffing for continued summer field maintenance.

title: End-of-season field maintenance and equipment planning
description: Plan fall cleanup and grounds equipment needs: mowers, sheds, bleachers, drag/trailer.

title: Batting cage project completion and payout
description: Complete the Douglass field batting cage project and process the payout.

title: Field improvements / infield mix / batting cage rebuild
description: Review Douglass field improvements: infield mix and batting cage rebuild.

title: Intervale & Douglass project updates
description: Update on Intervale project (dugouts, benches, fencing, King grant funded) and Douglass batting cage project (net, turf, gravel, cement).

title: End-of-season survey open to families
description: Launch the post-season survey to players' families and coaches capturing positives, negatives, and complaints for the board's season retrospective.

title: Season retrospective / survey review at board meeting
description: Present compiled end-of-season survey results and season recap/feedback to the board for the fall planning cycle.

title: Sponsorship / donor recognition update
description: Coordinate sponsor thank-you and donor management materials (plaques, banners, framed jerseys) alongside the president and sponsorship coordinator.

title: Registration opens - launch announcement
description: Push the season-open registration email to the full league population and run/promote open registration nights; begin tracking signup numbers by division.

title: Season calendar / key dates published
description: Finalize and post key dates (registration open, clinics, assessments, draft, season start, photo day, playoffs, All-Stars) to the website and email.

title: Website / IT refresh for new season
description: Update the information website: URL changes, division info pages, calendar, and registration-portal links for the coming season.

title: Certified Volunteer Process blast
description: Email all registered users the annual 3-step certification process (register, background check, yearly Abuse Awareness Training) and badge pickup details.

title: Registration update - division signup counts
description: Report division-by-division signup counts to the board as registration approaches close, flagging under- or over-subscribed divisions.

title: Assessment tally / rankings prepped for draft
description: Compile and adjust assessment tallies and player rankings for the board and player agent ahead of the drafts.

title: Photo Day scheduling with photographer
description: Coordinate picture/photo day dates with the photographer, tied to uniform delivery, and set makeup/backup dates.

title: Final registration / total player counts reported
description: Report final registration numbers and total player counts by division to the board once rosters are set.

title: Team photo scheduling for remaining teams
description: Work with the photographer to set up photo opportunities for any teams that still need photos during their remaining games.

title: Photo packet pickup / online order reminder
description: Remind families that photo packets are available for pickup and that photos are ordered directly through the online portal by the order deadline.

title: Ballpark family experience outings
description: Organize and announce major- and minor-league ballpark family outings for league families.

title: Merch / fanwear store open announcement
description: Announce the online merch store link for browsing/ordering, noting pickup-only/pre-order lead-time details.

title: Hat orders / merch site wind-down and refunds
description: Wind down the merch/hat store for the year and process any pending order refunds.

title: Post-season survey results review by division
description: Present post-season survey results and season discussion broken out by division at the end-of-year board meeting.

title: Annual elections / officer slate approval
description: Fill and approve the officer slate for the coming year via board motion at the fall organizational meeting. Confirm voting officers with owning role and term year, plus non-voting staff; note open seats.

title: Set fall/winter board meeting schedule
description: Establish the offseason board meeting cadence (monthly or bi-weekly) and next-season planning windows.

title: Yearly policy and rules review
description: Review and adopt division rules, managers/coaches contract, and volunteer application for the coming year.

title: Next-season planning kickoff
description: Draft registration timing, clinics, assessments, calendar, and coaches trainings for the coming spring season.

title: Sponsor thank-yous and fundraising follow-up
description: Coordinate sponsor thank-yous (banners, signed jerseys, donation letters) and fundraising follow-up by donation tier.

title: Registration fees and open date decision
description: Set registration fees by division and the registration open date (historically 1/1) with the board.

title: Board Meeting - fall business
description: Facilitate the fall board meeting: financials, field projects, season calendar, motions/votes, and action items. President facilitates; secretary records.

title: Winter clinics planning
description: Plan January winter clinics (softball and baseball) - dates, gym space, coaches, budget, and session fees.

title: Assessment dates and structure
description: Set spring assessment/tryout dates and structure (stations, judges, snow/rain dates).

title: Abuse Awareness Training reset
description: Abuse Awareness Training resets October 1; ensure all board members complete it and hold current Safe Sport badges.

title: Board positions / open-seat recruitment
description: Confirm/retain roles, fill open seats, and recruit volunteers for the coming season.

title: Registration opens for spring season
description: Broadcast registration-open announcement to all families, including tee ball/coach pitch details, winter clinics, and custom-uniform sign-up deadline.

title: Assessments/tryouts planning
description: Plan player assessments: dates, stations, assessors/judges, equipment per station, check-in, and snow/rain date.

title: Spring training / indoor practice scheduling
description: Secure gym/YMCA space and schedule indoor practices with volunteers.

title: Rules / division review
description: Review division rules and interleague rule changes (farm system, coach pitch, age structure, playing-up).

title: Assessments reminder to families
description: Remind families of assessment dates, what to bring, parent meeting, medical release form, and per-division schedule.

title: Coach interviews
description: Invite and interview coaches; hold the board's ranked-choice vetting vote per division.

title: Coach selection and team counts
description: Motions to elect coaches and set the number of teams per level; review play-up/move-up requests for safety and balance.

title: Draft dates set
description: Set draft dates (held after the coaches meeting); enforce the 3/14 final custom-jersey registration deadline.

title: Season calendar finalized
description: Finalize the season calendar: clinics, assessments, coaches clinics, draft, field cleanups, first games, All-Star letters/dates.

title: Division draft invites
description: Invite head/assistant coaches to division drafts; propose candidate evenings and share coach lists and meeting link.

title: Draft results and team names
description: Release per-team rosters and practice schedules; collect ranked team-name choices with coin-flip tiebreaker.

title: Publish rosters after draft
description: Ensure drafted teams are entered into GameChanger and rosters posted (secretary executes).

title: Optional pre-season practices announcement
description: Announce optional pre-season/outdoor practices to families with GameChanger app link and weather caveats.

title: {{district}} updates and All-Star tournament dates
description: Distribute {{district}} updates, interleague forms, and All-Star tournament dates.

title: Schedules update to families
description: Broadcast season-opening practice/game schedule status per division, directing families to GameChanger.

title: Snack Shack / concessions setup
description: Coordinate Snack Shack setup and staffing (including softball snack shack) for the start of games.

title: Field etiquette and start times broadcast
description: Broadcast field rules, start times, arrival windows, and safety/neighbor-respect reminders to families.

title: All-Star commitment forms due
description: All-Star commitment form due; coaches must submit a full slate of 14 players or the nomination is not accepted.

title: Playoffs scheduling and end-of-season BBQ
description: Schedule playoffs and plan the end-of-season BBQ / Home Run Derby.

title: All-Star team and coach selection
description: Hold All-Star roster votes by division/level and elect head/assistant coaches pending background checks.

title: All-Star roster board approval
description: Board approval of finalized All-Star team rosters per division.

title: Team-not-fielded notice
description: Notify families when a division does not have enough commitments to field an All-Star team.

title: Coach conduct reminder
description: Send gentle game-conduct reminders to coaches as summer ball proceeds, especially after any parent complaint.

title: Board Meeting - fall/summer business
description: Facilitate the post-season/fall business meeting: survey review, fall ball counts, banquet/parade planning, and board elections scheduling.

title: Following-year calendar drafting
description: Draft the following year's calendar: registration, clinics, assessments, coaches clinics, season dates, and All-Stars.

title: Abuse Awareness Training resets (Oct 1)
description: Little League's Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport training resets October 1. All board members and volunteers must re-complete it for the new fiscal year, even if they completed it last year or through another organization.

title: ASAP safety plan and AED device review
description: Review and refresh the ASAP (As Safe As Possible) safety plan for the coming year and confirm all AED devices are present, charged, and serviceable. Present findings to the board.

title: Board Abuse Awareness training compliance push
description: Following the Oct 1 reset, drive all board members to complete Abuse Awareness training and track certificates. A Safe Sport badge is required to work with players.

title: ASAP Plan & AED devices review (winter planning)
description: Update the ASAP plan and confirm AED device status as part of winter/pre-season board planning.

title: Coaches clinic & LL-required safety meeting scheduling
description: Schedule the annual coaches clinic and the Little League-required Safety & First Aid training (now mandatory, tied to the PCA coaching clinic). Coordinate date, venue, and instructor.

title: Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport compliance check
description: Verify all board members and returning volunteers have current Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport certification and Safe Sport badges before the season ramps up.

title: ASAP Plan & AED devices review (pre-season)
description: Final pre-season review of the ASAP plan and AED devices ahead of assessments, drafts, and the start of practices.

title: AED / CPR (Heartsaver) clinic offered; ASAP plan start
description: Offer and subsidize an AED/CPR (Heartsaver) clinic for coaches and volunteers, kick off the ASAP plan for the season, and continue Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport training tracking.

title: Coaches meeting & LL Safety and First Aid training
description: Hold the pre-season coaches meeting with the Little League-required Safety & First Aid training so all coaches are certified before games begin.

title: Safety base installation before games begin
description: Install break-away safety bases at all fields before the first games of the season. Confirm each field is game-ready.

title: Abuse Awareness compliance for board members (in-season)
description: Follow up on any outstanding Abuse Awareness training for board members and volunteers so everyone on the field remains a Certified Volunteer.

title: AED devices update & CPR/Heartsaver clinic scheduling
description: Provide an in-season AED device update and schedule additional CPR / Heartsaver clinics as needed for coaches and volunteers.

title: ASAP / SAFE Plan initiation
description: Ensure the ASAP / SAFE plan is fully initiated and copies are carried by all coaches at games and practices, including completed medical release forms.

title: AED devices and CPR / safety clinic updates
description: Late-season update on AED devices and any remaining CPR/safety clinic sessions ahead of All-Stars and summer ball.

title: ASAP Plan update (post-season / tournament)
description: Update the ASAP plan for post-season and tournament play, ensuring All-Star and summer teams have current safety documentation and AED coverage.

title: Abuse Awareness training reset reminder (approaching Oct 1)
description: Abuse Awareness training resets October 1. Remind all board members and volunteers that they must re-complete the course for the new fiscal year.

title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (fall cycle)
description: Review and update the league Constitution & By-laws and upload the current version to Little League International. Treated as a recurring governance obligation each cycle.

title: Record annual officer slate / elections roster
description: Capture the elected officer slate and positions roster (voting officers with owning role and term year, plus non-voting staff and open seats) in the minutes when the board holds elections. {{leagueAbbrev}} has run elections in Oct, Nov, and March cycles.

title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI
description: Recurring review/update of the Constitution & By-laws with upload to Little League International, including any newly adopted policies (e.g., Social Media Policy, advertising/sponsorship policy under review).

title: Publish meeting agenda and minutes to the board
description: After each board meeting, distribute the agenda and approved minutes via document link so members can review and flag omissions. Standing recordkeeping duty tied to the monthly/bi-weekly meeting cadence.

title: Opening Day Snack Shack volunteer recruitment blast
description: Send the bulk Snack Shack volunteer recruitment email to a division's families ahead of Opening Day, using the Sign Up Genius link to fill concession slots (children/players not permitted in the snack shack for the event).

title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (spring cycle)
description: Recurring in-season review/upload of the governing documents to LLI, ensuring the charter-year version on file reflects any mid-year policy adoptions.

title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (year-end)
description: End-of-fiscal-year review and update of the Constitution & By-laws with upload to Little League International, closing out the governance cycle before Oct 1 reset.

title: Financial / Treasury update at board meeting
description: Present bank and PayPal/online balances, outstanding invoices/obligations, and P&L/budget notes at the board meeting; recurring at each meeting throughout the year.

title: Pay Little League charter & insurance fees (annual renewal)
description: Authorize and pay the annual LL charter & insurance renewal (Nov-Dec, ~$1,300; authorized up to $2,000 in recent years).

title: Registration fees set for coming season
description: Confirm registration fee schedule with the board (e.g. Juniors $150, Majors/AAA $140, AA $110, A/CP/TB $80, Sandlot add-on $20) ahead of the 1/1 registration open date.

title: Sponsorship / fundraising drive kickoff
description: Launch sponsorship letters, banners, plaques, and thank-yous; set team sponsorship level ($375-$475) and manage donor tiers (banner logo $200+, dye-sub jersey $500+, signed jersey $1,000+).

title: Tournament fundraising launch
description: Begin fundraising for advancing All-Star teams (hotels, mileage, uniforms, meals); set fundraising goal (e.g. {{amount}} for Regionals) and coordinate buckets/GoFundMe/business donations.

title: Donation bucket collection run
description: Check the mailbox and donation buckets at partner businesses (B&R Dairy, Birchwood, Two Mums, Brickyard Hollow, etc.) and deposit proceeds.

title: Post-tournament family disbursement
description: Disburse hotel, per diem, and gas reimbursements to tournament families per policy (per diem $50/day/family, rooms $200/day, mileage at federal charity rate; receipts per applicable year's rule).

title: Vote on tournament family stipend
description: Bring the tournament family stipend (e.g. 14 families) to the board for a spending motion and vote.

title: Fall uniform sampling and pricing kickoff
description: Begin gathering vendor samples and pricing for the coming season ({{uniformVendor}}, Main Street Graphics, {{equipmentVendor}}), including girl's-cut softball options, and note jersey ordering deadlines for board discussion.

title: Early-signup jersey deadline planning
description: Review uniform sampling and pricing and confirm the early-signup custom-uniform incentive and its jersey deadline so registration messaging can promote it.

title: Uniform vendor quotes and jersey layout due
description: Finalize vendor quotes, sponsor-on-front jersey layout, girl's-cut softball fit, and the customized-jersey deadline for board review ahead of ordering.

title: Early-signup custom jersey deadline (Feb 15)
description: Early-signup incentive cutoff for customized uniforms; players registered by this date qualify for a personalized jersey.

title: Uniform purchase decision at board meeting
description: Present final vendor pick, team sizes and extras, and per-player budget for a spending motion; confirm the order can hit the vendor deadline.

title: Customized jersey registration deadline (3/14)
description: Final registration deadline to receive a customized jersey - no exceptions. Teams finalized by this date; players registering after receive a generic backup jersey.

title: {{uniformVendor}} order deadline
description: Submit the AAA-and-above {{uniformVendor}} uniform order plus Gilbert hats by the vendor cutoff (around late March).

title: Uniform sizing event
description: Host the pre-order sizing event with jersey and pant samples for players to try on; last chance to correct fit before final order adjustments go in.

title: Uniform delivery tracking begins
description: Track incoming uniform shipments from vendors and coordinate timing with picture day so teams have uniforms before photos and opening games.

title: Coach uniform pickup window
description: Uniforms are ready for coaches or one team representative to collect and distribute; parents do not pick up individually. After-hours access via storage code.

title: All-Star uniform ordering
description: Order All-Star team jerseys and uniforms (about {{amount}}/player) once rosters are voted, following per-player budget approvals.

title: Junior/Senior summer uniform procurement
description: Procure Junior and Senior uniforms for advancing and summer-ball teams as those rosters are set.

title: Uniform vendor/pricing research review
description: Ongoing project: research uniform vendors and pricing options to inform next season's sampling and ordering decisions.

title: Junior & Senior baseball commitment letters due
description: Collect Junior & Senior baseball commitment responses (due Nov 30) and publish the roster by Nov 1 so summer-season Junior/Senior teams can be planned early in the FY.

title: Spring indoor practice / clinic schedule set
description: Finalize the clinic-style indoor practice schedule (gym/YMCA time slots, Saturday sessions into April) for AA/AAA/Majors, coordinating coaches and pooled stations before teams move to the fields.

title: Draft complete - build team practice/game schedules
description: With drafts done and teams finalized, work with coaches and the scheduler to lay out division practice and game schedules ahead of the season start (approx. April 10).

title: Game & practice schedules posted in GameChanger
description: Publish and update AA/AAA/Majors baseball (and coordinate Tee Ball/Coach Pitch/Softball) practice and game schedules in GameChanger with correct start dates, fields, and times.

title: Playoff schedule, rules & brackets announcement
description: Send the league-wide baseball playoff email covering the schedule by division, seeding/home-team rules, pitch-count regulations, AA player-pitch clarifications, and bracket formats (single vs double elimination). See playoffs_tournament__baseball-playoff-schedule-rules.md.

title: Summer baseball registration & season setup
description: Open summer baseball / summer-ball registration and set up the summer season (divisions, rosters, schedules) as the regular season wraps into playoffs.

title: Season retrospective - baseball divisions
description: Review the post-season survey and division feedback for baseball (AA/AAA/Majors/Juniors/Seniors) to feed next-year rule, structure, and scheduling planning.

title: Softball parent discussion group meeting (bi-weekly)
description: Recurring softball parent/board discussion group covering officer roles, coming-season scheduling and travel, field improvements, equipment, uniforms, and District/high school game opportunities. Open to all softball parents to build pathways for softball success and equitability.

title: Softball program improvements & recruitment planning
description: Post-season review of the softball program: identify improvement areas, recruitment strategies to grow enrollment across divisions, and any division mergers with neighboring leagues (e.g., Majors softball with Yarmouth) when counts are low.

title: Softball program planning - recruitment, clinics, team formation
description: Winter planning for softball: recruitment push, {{instructorName}} winter softball clinic coordination, and preliminary team formation across softball divisions ahead of assessments.

title: Softball uniform & equipment needs (girl's cut) input
description: Provide softball-specific input to uniform and equipment coordinators: girl's cut jerseys, softball-sized balls, catcher's gear, and required infield face masks for all softball positions.

title: Memorial Day Parade participation
description: Organize softball teams' participation in the Memorial Day parade - line up players, coordinate banners and route logistics with the board.

title: Memorial Day parade - softball turnout
description: Confirm softball division turnout for the parade and coordinate with information officer and grounds for staging.

title: Softball program roles staffing
description: Recruit and confirm softball program staff for the coming year: VP Softball, Softball Equipment, Softball Concessions, Media, and Scheduler. Fill open seats ahead of board elections.
